comment: S21 Parts 3-4: the quest & rumor text pack v1 (docs/quest-text-pack-v1.md), planner-authored — wired as data, never rewritten here. Placeholders: {town} {region} {target} {card} {reward} {steps} {want}.

courier: A parcel for {town}, wrapped in oilcloth and questions. Don't open it. {reward} on delivery.
My sister in {town} needs this before the roads worsen. They always worsen.
This letter outlived two couriers already. Third time pays for all — {reward}, when it reaches {town}.
Take the ledger to {town}. Walk quickly and read nothing.
cardCourier: A collector in {town} wants {want} — wants it gone from here, more like. It travels the moment we shake on it.
The {want} in your keeping would settle an old debt in {town}. Old debts pay new gold.
There's a buyer in {town} for {want}. Ask no questions and carry none with it.
bounty: {target} has been seen on the {region} roads. The purse stands at {reward}, and it stands lonely.
Whatever walks the {region} wearing that shape — the reeve wants it stopped. {reward}, no questions on the manner.
Third caravan this season. The {region} pays {reward} to whoever ends it.
retrieval: It's in the lair in the {region} — past the resident, which is the whole trouble. Bring it back or keep it; we'll pay either way you choose wrong.
My grandmother's {card} went into that den with my grandmother. The {card}, at least, can come back.
The thing you want sits behind the thing you don't. {reward} if it reaches me.

chainLinks: Ask at {town} — the ferryman there saw where it went.
The shepherds in the {region} tell it differently. Go hear them tell it.
Old {town} charcoal-burners know that country. Buy a round and buy the truth.

guardians.reya: In the Last Chapel they bury no one twice. She won't allow it.
guardians.arcanis: The hermit of the Reach reads three futures in a breath. Bring him a fourth.
guardians.drana: The Barrowlands' mistress tithes in blood, and pays her debts in it too.
guardians.drakuseth: Brand's folk saw wings over the caldera at dusk. Three farms burned in a single pass.
guardians.titania: Fell a tree in the Deepwood, then count your breaths until the ground answers.

lords.unwinder: The tide at the Spire runs backward, and what it takes comes back wrong.
lords.usher: The duchess of the old court receives all the dead, and returns none.
lords.warden: The walls of the Bastion are alive, and the tallest of them holds the keys.
lords.stoker: Every spell spoken near the Furnace Gate, something inside hears it. And grows hungrier.
lords.sower: Plant nothing within sight of the Throne. It will grow, and it will not be yours.

rumors.moxPointer: There's a door in the {region} that opens for no key. Something older than keys waits behind it.
rumors.moxPointerDeep: Five doors, five sleepless things, five prizes that were old when the strongholds were quarried.
rumors.vaultTease: Five seats of power, five treasures taken. And beneath them all, they say — a flower.
rumors.nighthawkLegend: They found the last one drained white on the fen road, purse untouched. Walk wide of the Nighthawk — or walk in numbers, and count the payout worth it.
warp: The old currents run crosswise in this country. Some call it opportunity. Widows call it otherwise.
Five powers ride the crossed currents, and the riding frays the plane. Ask why the birds fly widdershins near the spokes' ends.
texture: The roads are the reeve's as far as the lanterns reach. Past that, they're whoever's walking them.
Whitewell's bell rings itself some mornings. Nobody mends it. Nobody dares.
The wild towns trade in things the civilized ones pretend not to want.
Steps are cheap, they say. They say it young.
rumors.manalinkPointer: There's work in {town} that pays in something better than coin. That kind of work doesn't wait.

corolla.doorOpen: Five seats stand empty, and the world has gone quiet spoke by spoke. What the lords rode has no riders now. The petals part.
corolla.doorLocked: The petals are closed. {n} seats still hold their sovereigns.
corolla.vaultOpen: Five gems, five sleepless things put to sleep. The Vault opens on what you carry — and shows it back to you.
corolla.vaultLocked: Locked. It counts gems, and you are short.

petals.B: The Court is dust. The Tithe still collects — here it wears the hearth's colours, and the collector smiles.
petals.R: The Gate is cold and the Toll is not. Something in the deep keeps the count, and it counts in depths.
petals.W: The Bastion's walls are down; the Intake stands. What arrives here arrives bound — and she moves first.
petals.U: The Spire is silent and the tide still rises. What is spent here grows back, and grows back wilder.
petals.G: The Throne is empty and the Season keeps its turning. Everything here musters. Everything here grows.

corolla.townStrip: The heart. The world stands still here, and so may you.
corolla.inn: Rest costs nothing here. Nothing is what time is worth, this deep.
corolla.shelf: The flower's own wares. Nowhere else stocks these; nowhere else could.
corolla.heartLocked: Five petals. {n} have fallen. The heart does not open for the impatient.
corolla.petalFalls: A petal falls. Its minister comes with you, and the two currents it kept.
corolla.mirrorYields: The reflection yields what it carried. There is exactly one, and now it is yours.
corolla.petalLost: The petal holds. You are left where you fell; the flower does not press its advantage.

heart.doorOpen: The petals are gone. What they grew from is waiting.
heart.telegraph: Here the currents meet. Five laws fell to you, and the thing that grew them has not fallen — it will grow them again as fast as you can cut them, one each night, in the order the plane runs. It has a name. You will read it on the card, and nowhere else. The heart does not offer terms.
heart.stakes: Nothing is wagered here. The flower has nothing to lose that it cannot regrow, and you have already given the road everything it asked.
heart.flavor: Five petals. Five laws. Five who thought the laws were theirs. Beneath them all, the flower — which never noticed it was being ruled.
heart.victory: The flower folds. The laws fall silent in the same breath, and the currents slow and feel for their old beds. This is not an ending. A petal closes; the world remembers who closed it. For now.
heart.victoryCard: Its card is yours. There is exactly one.
heart.loss: The flower stands. You are left at the heart, where nothing presses you. Rest, and return; it will be here.
heart.offer: Stay in the quiet world, or begin again on a new road — carrying what you carried out.

chronicle.W: Cut from the white road: the flower folded, and for a season the pale country's wounds did not close on their own. Whatever the flower was doing, it was doing that too.
chronicle.U: Cut from the blue road: the tide at the Spire ran forward for the first time anyone remembers. Then it thought better of it.
chronicle.B: Cut from the black road: the barrows were quiet, and then they were not quiet in a new way. The dead have opinions about flowers.
chronicle.R: Cut from the red road: the Caldera cooled a hand's breadth. Ash fell upward for a day.
chronicle.G: Cut from the green road: the Deepwood grew a ring of new trunks overnight, every one of them leaning toward the heart.

heart.fifthCutting: Five cuttings. The flower folds slower each time, and each time it folds, something under it turns over — like a sleeper deciding which side to face. The currents no longer run where they ran. Whatever comes next will not be Cinquefoil as you knew it.
heart.newRoad: You have cut the flower from the {colour} road. You begin with what you carried out: {power}, {guardian}, and {minister}.
heart.newRoadAll: You have cut the flower from every road. You begin with everything you carried out — and the plane has noticed.
heart.withheld: Its minister is already yours. The petal yields coin instead, and the two currents it kept.
heart.chronicleHeader: The Chronicle of Cuttings — the Manafleur, and what followed each folding.
